svg.title: C11-M07-F1: Secrets versus identity
svg.desc: Three patterns from static keys in code, to secrets fetched by identity, to short-lived identity tokens, plus CI federation.
svg.text: BAD code/ENV/image -> static key -> cloud API (leaks, never expires)
OK workload -> secrets manager (by identity) -> secret -> service
BEST workload identity -> short-lived token -> cloud API (no secret)
CI pipeline OIDC token -> STS / Entra federation -> short-lived creds
Figure C11-M07-F1. From static secrets to workload identity.
